title: the light: every way to switch it
notes: bss-8. The same states for every Bench Solution of the UNO light bench, whatever route its firmware variant reads the button by (external interrupt on D2, pin-change interrupt on D4, a voltage on A0) or drives the LED by (a GPIO, the timer PWM, the kit's transistor). Roles resolve per Bench Solution to the Hardware Events its own firmware offers; executions resolve their isotope from the variant's route knobs. Requirements: a number is exact; an enum label is exact; 'written' means changed on the edge; 'a..b' a range; 'a|b' a set.

roles.press: the person presses the board's pushbutton (the firmware's asserted edge or level on the button's pin)
roles.command: a SET_LED command from a Polari screen arrives through the bridge
roles.reset: the person presses reset: back through init
roles.period: the telemetry period elapses: one LightState frame leaves

collaterals.notes: R=220 (the kit's 220 ohm series resistor, board.custom.kit_parts); the LED is the generic indicator model (a knob: measure the kit LED's Vf); bound = the UNO pin's 20 mA limit, above 5 mA to be seen lit
